relay.agent_avatar.alt.note: Accessible name (alt text) of an agent's round profile picture on the phone (chat header, session list). {name} is the agent's display name. Short noun phrase, no period.

relay.agent_avatar.change.note: Accessible label of the control on the agent's picture in the phone chat header; activating it explains where the picture can be changed. {name} is the agent's display name. Imperative, no period. Same meaning as the desktop app's pencil overlay label.

relay.agent_avatar.desktop_hint.note: Transient snackbar shown on the phone when the person taps or long-presses an agent's picture in the chat header: the phone app has no picture editor, the desktop app's Agents page does. No period (snackbar line). 'desktop app' = the Local Operator desktop application.
